beta.notes:
New in this version:
• Checking, downloading and preparing an update all happen in the update window. Downloads have a real Cancel, and an update you put off comes back through the banner.
• The grading page's bottom band is one paper surface. Page tools sit on their own tab, and a thumbnail's grip shows only while the pointer is over it.
• The grade comment sits in the grading row and grows as you type, then folds when you click away. On the Chat tab it waits as a dashed bubble until you choose Post to thread or Keep with the grade.
• Task has its own tab between Chat and Rubric, and Chat runs the full height of the panel with the reply box at the bottom.
• The demo tour brings each step's screen forward and hands you a worksheet to drag on the drop step. Its slides always play.
• Automatic pre-grading now skips only work already graded in Schoology, and pre-grades everything else in any learning period. Turn it on or off from the To-do menu.
• A pre-grade with any model output shows it with a banner instead of stopping. One that does stop says why and what to do next.
• Reading & AI: click anywhere on a None, OCR only or OCR + AI card. Auto-configure says what this computer can run and suggests a model that fits.
• Grade and Choose work the same way across learning periods, and a student's row unfolds out of its header as one motion. Work not yet graded opens in Grade, and a missing upload offers Check upload.
• The Appearance, PDF output and Schoology settings pages are tidier, with matching controls and aligned rows.
• The welcome wizard's folder step shows the records it found as one clear card, and the setup screens share one look.

Fixes:
• Up and down arrows on number boxes respond when clicked.
• The window no longer freezes briefly at a session's first message, and report card progress stays smooth while a job runs.
• Long student names in To-do shorten with an ellipsis instead of being cut off.
• If a window won't close for an update, Buddy says so and keeps the update ready.

stable.notes:
New in this version:
• When complete grading is unavailable, Quick feedback prepares editable general advice without inventing a grade. The banner explains the limitation and the next useful action.
• The feedback dropdown offers Deeper review to attempt every page using the existing reading tools. Page coverage is reported, and teacher comments, grades and intentionally cleared comments are preserved.
• The rubric dropdown gently highlights ambiguous matches, outdated choices and workbook activities needing selection. Quick feedback remains available without choosing a rubric.

Fixes:
• Unread pages are identified as a reading limitation instead of an AI connection problem. Incomplete evidence does not produce a grade, and changing the rubric is not suggested as a remedy for unread pages.
• AI connection errors open the current Reading & AI connection settings instead of the retired advanced three-model configuration screen.
